Name: NPC Pei Ming
Author: voidcultist666
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[left][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/void-cultist/PeiMingSDV/refs/heads/main/banner.png[/img][/left][size=3]
This mod adds the custom NPC [b]Pei Ming[/b] from the Chinese novel series "Heaven Officials' Blessing" by Mo Xiang Tong Xiu to Stardew Valley, attempting to flesh out the character beyond what the novels had reduced him to. No knowledge of the story will be required to use this mod as it was written for all players in mind. As of now, he has several heart events and other events that will be expanded upon in the upcoming months, so stay tuned![/size]

[line][/font]
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][size=5][b]About the Character[/b][/size][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]In the books, Pei Ming is also known as General Ming Guang and the Martial God of the North - and on top of that, he is said to be the second strongest martial god next to the Heavenly Emperor himself! But because he is known to be quite flirtatious and knowing his way around women especially, he additionally received the title of "God of Love". For some reason, he ended up in Stardew Valley and is not too happy about it. Good thing the farmer likes to help everyone and their grandma, no?  
[/size]

[/font][line]
[font=Trebuchet MS][center]﻿[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font][size=5][b]Storyline [/b][/size][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/font][/size][/center][size=3]This mod features a storyline in which the farmer can befriend Pei Ming and even invite him to become roommates (more about that in the further sections). His story progresses the more hearts the farmer has with him and currently spans up to 7 heart events - more of which will be implemented in future updates that are currently being worked on. Can the farmer help a literal god from another time to reconnect to his old realm? [/size]
﻿
[line]
[center]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/b][/font] [size=5][b]Config Options[/b]﻿[/size] [font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/b][/font][/center]
[size=3]This mod aims to be as customizable as possible. As of version 1.1.0, there are the following config options that can be accessed using [font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or by [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Configure_mods]editing the config.json[/url][/font] that will be created upon launching the game with the mod installed for the first time. The options are as follows:[/size][/font]
[quote][center]﻿[/center][size=2][b][u][/u][/b][center][b][u]﻿House Location[/u][/b]
[u]Options[/u]: Vanilla, SVE, Alternate
Pei Ming's house is located in the forest near the Hat Mouse's hut. [b]If you use SVE, you must change the setting to either SVE or Alternate[/b]. If you don't, you can use Vanilla or Alternate. Alternate provides an extra custom map near the Wizard's house and can be used in vanilla and SVE save files both without causing compatibility issues. Check the "Images" tab to see what each configuration looks like.
[b]Do not change the House Location from either Vanilla or SVE to Alternate mid-game or the warp will not work as intended. Change this setting from the title menu only or restart your game.[/b]

[b][u]Portrait Style[/u][/b]
[u]Options[/u]: Default, Alternate
This mod comes with two different sets of portraits. You can check which one appeals to you the most in the "Images" tab. The portraits do not change the overworld sprites. Both sets have specific sprites for Winter and the beach.

[b][u]Festival Participation[/u][/b]
Depending on how many mods you use, festivals can get quite crowded with NPCs stepping onto each other. Toggle this setting if you don't want Pei Ming to attend festivals to retain compatibility with other custom NPCs

[b][u]Partnership[/u][/b]
[u]Options[/u]: Roommate, Platonic Partnership
Pei Ming is an NPC that can become the farmer's roommate. In this mod, he was written to be[url=https://aroworlds.com/allo-aro/allo-aro-101/] allo-aro[/url]﻿. Changing the configs, you can choose whether you want him to behave [b]like a vanilla roommate with his new roommate schedule[/b] intact or as [b]platonic partner which will make him ignore the roommate schedule [/b]and adhere to a custom one.

[size=2][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/36/Emote_Exclamation.png[/img][/size]
﻿Please keep in mind that the latter is highly experimental and might come with bugs that are hard to circumvent despite thorough testing due to hardcoded limitations. None of those bugs are gamebreaking but could involve dialogue lines not firing, the spouse room disappearing etc. Please do report if you run into any issues. Do not change the relationship style in your save file as it might lead to bugs or unpredictable NPC behavior. If you want to try another relationship style, please create a new save.[/center][center]﻿[/center][center][b][u]Flirtatiousness[/u][/b]
Pei Ming is usually playfully flirty, occasionally overstepping boundaries with his remarks. If this is something that makes you uncomfortable, you can toggle it off - this will change some of his dialogue lines.
[u][b]
[/b][/u][u][b]
[/b][/u][u][b]Custom Music[/b][/u]
This mod adds custom music tracks to certain events and locations involving Pei Ming. If you do not want this, turn this setting off. Custom music might also slow down your game in some instances, so if you are experiencing lag, disable this config as well.[/center]
[/size][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS]

[line]
[center][size=5][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font]﻿[b]Compatibility [/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font][/size][/center]
[size=3]Mods that neatly tie in with this one and enhance it, some of them have added compatibility, but none of them are required.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia More Flowers[/url]: additional gift tastes for Pei Ming and spawns in custom Location[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/Polyamory]Polyamory Mod[/url]: enables polyamory setting [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10062]Hugs and Kisses[/url]: for Roommate kisses! yay![/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]: custom relationship labels! [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42801]Merchant[/url]﻿: Pei Ming has dialogue lines as custome[/size]
[/list][size=3]Other than that, the mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. Should compatibility issues with other mods pop up, please let me know.

[/size][line]
[center][size=5][b][font=Trebuchet MS][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/b][/font][/font]Installation[font=Trebuchet MS][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/b][/font][/font]
[/b][/size][/center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]
After downloading the zip file, unpack it and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]move its contents into your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]﻿. Make sure that all of the required mods (check the requirements!), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are installed and up to date.[/font][/size][size=3]

If you want to use this mod in an existing save, it is recommended to use [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Console_commands#world_clear]SMAPI's cleanup command[/url] or [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases/tag/1.0.3-unofficial.3-Lake1059]Reset Terrain Features[/url] as parts of his map patches might be obstructed by trees, bushes etc.[/size]

[line][center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font][size=5][b]Plans for the future/Roadmap[/b][/size][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/0/0d/Stardew_Valley_Rose.png[/img][/size][/font][/b][/b][/size][/font][/center]
[size=3]This mod is not completed at all - I have a lot of plans for its future that I am already actively working on. But I finally wanted to get the initial version out there to collect feedback which I can use to improve on it even further. Some of the plans include:

[/size][center][size=3]Finishing Pei Ming's main story line by adding Heart Events 8 - 14
more events with the Vanilla NPCs
new items and (special) quests
more dialogue lines
obligatory bug fixes 
and more![/size][/center][size=3]
[/size][line]
[center][b][size=5][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/29/Emote_Heart.png[/img]﻿Thank you![font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=5][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/29/Emote_Heart.png[/img][/size][/b][/font][/size][/b][/center][center]﻿[/center]
[size=3]This is the very first time I ventured into the more technical side of modding. I have always used mods in all kinds of games I played but this time around, I wanted to be the one making something fun! This entire project would never have been possible with a lot of people that helped and supported me and still do, so a big big thank you goes to

[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]orangemilk/pastelshrooms for actually sparking the idea for this mod by making a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39011]mod that replaces Elliott with Pei Ming[/url]﻿ - I don't think I would have made it past the sprite making stage so I am eternally grateful that they let me use theirs for this <3 [/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][url=https://chaosaki.tumblr.com/]Aki[/url]﻿, the person who this mod is actually dedicated to. We tried the mod I mentioned above and went "haha what if he were an NPC" and I could not be stopped from that point onward. She also helped me tremendously with the creative writing of this mod - a lot of the dialogue and the events has been written by her! She also bravely endured my ramblings, my mod-making-hyperfocus and playtested this thing![/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Claude who started their modding journey vaguely around the same time as I did and who always lights the mood there! Can't wait for the Dwarbus mod to drop.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/handwrittenhello?gameId=1303]Nic[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/mods]Airyn [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Aba[/url]﻿: Not only do I love their mods, they also helped me greatly with about everything I attempted to do. Reading through my silly json files, guiding me through the steps and explaining stuff patiently - I don't think I'd even have a functioning schedule for this NPC without them. Check out their mods <3[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]And so many others from the mod maker community that helped or motivated me the one or other time: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]Chu[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons/mods]Button[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AtlasV1224/mods]Atlas[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BeazNees/mods]Bea[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish/mods]Dolphin[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480 [/url]﻿and probably so many more that I feel bad for doing them a disservice by not listing them here. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]the sneeb[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]my cats for interrupting me at least twice a minute[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
For 1.1.0, I want to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato/mods]mushymato[/url]﻿, for providing an unused custom quest type code, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/boxosoup]boxosoup[/url]﻿, who then worked on and finetuned said code so I could implement a specific type of quest[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3].

Do check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/VoidWitchCult]voidwitchcult[/url]'s stuff as well. I used their[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/9bf8a95bf8] base sprites [/url]for the NPC added in 1.1.0. [/size][size=1](no, we are not the same person. Or are we?)[/size][size=3]
